name: console-growth
description: Developer console for an LLM API, seeded with one account, used to practice shipping instrumented growth experiments

scripts.dev: node scripts/stop.js && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "node --watch-path=server server/index.js" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm --prefix client run build && NODE_ENV=production API_PORT=3000 node server/index.js
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
